question: What will the month-over-month change in US producer prices excluding food, energy, and trade services be for October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: 2026 monthly prints of PPI ex food/energy/trade (0.3,0.5,?,0.6,0.8,0.1,0.4,0.3,0.5) average ~0.42 with SD ~0.2; long-run avg 0.24. Upside: crude ~$100, diesel/freight costs, tariff pass-through, 5.0% y/y momentum. Downside: Sept transportation & warehousing +3.4% may partially reverse; retail gasoline eased in Oct; mean reversion seen after hot months (May 0.8 -> June 0.1). TE forecast for this series 0.5%. Market check: no Polymarket/Manifold market; Kalshi has a HEADLINE PPI MoM Oct market (~52% >0.4, ~47% >0.5 per search snippet) — different series, used only as loose evidence. Median 0.4.
